title: Stream-role subtitle, attachment and font reads are not wrapped in Retry
notes: Items.Source in subtitles.go (lines 72, 246, 336, 457) and transcode.FetchSubtitle, FetchSup and StartFonts use the pool directly. Auth now waits, so a request that starts while Postgres is away waits as intended. A request that passes auth just before the outage, or one started after a brief blip, gets s.fail 500 on the first failed query. This is the same 500 the task forbids for the stream role Promoted to JS-146.
